hooks.command: cat >/dev/null || true; command -v code-review-graph >/dev/null 2>&1 && code-review-graph status || true
cat >/dev/null || true; command -v code-review-graph >/dev/null 2>&1 && nohup code-review-graph build --if-locked=skip </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &

cat >/dev/null || true; command -v code-review-graph >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; code-review-graph update --skip-flows --if-locked=skip; rc=$?; case $rc in 0|75) exit 0 ;; *) echo "code-review-graph update failed (exit $rc)" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
